name: Domain of Blessing: Crumbling Assembly I
description:
An ancient ruined city that was once used by a now-bygone secret order as an ad-hoc site of assembly.
Now, all that remains to rule the roost are beasts bereft of language or intellect. Defeat them, and you may claim precious artifacts.
rewardItems: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods
mechanics: After a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by the Crystallize reaction, they will gain the Crystal Empowerment state. The ATK of active characters in this state is increased by 20% for 10s. This state can stack up to 3 times, with the duration of each stack counted independently. If another Elemental Shard is obtained while you already have 3 stacks, release a Geo shockwave that deals Geo DMG to nearby opponents. 1 such shockwave can be triggered every 10s.
